title: feat(e2k1): late-enter-body keeps k=1 reverse: t=3 vs t=5
science: Introduces late-enter-body eps2 = mu + cost 3 on a 2->3 hop only when max_i|w_i| >= 2, designed precisely to dodge #6808's k=1 kill. It works at k=1 on B_6: t=3 vs 5, 27>25, small-k bar kept. Runner exhibits eps2_small=1 vs eps_small=3 and eps2_late=3 vs mu_late=1, so the clause is live but not on the k=1 geodesic.
